Nick Beavis, PhD

I am currently an undergraduate student of physics at University of Toronto with the long term aim of conducting academic research in theoretical early-universe cosmology. Formerly a research engineer.

Research interests

Theoretical early-universe cosmology, particularly inflation and particle cosmology, quantum cosmology and quantum foundations.
